nodes.name: recorder.py
nodes.summary: SQL query recorder and profiler for debugging. Intercepts database queries, captures call stacks, timing, EXPLAIN output, and cProfile data. Stores results in Redis for inspection via the Recorder UI. Supports recording HTTP requests, background jobs, and direct function calls.

nodes.name: RecorderConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding recorder configuration (record_requests, record_jobs, record_sql, capture_stack, profile, explain, filters). Stores/retrieves config from Redis cache with auto-disable expiry.

nodes.name: Recorder
nodes.summary: Main recorder class that patches frappe.db.sql to intercept queries. Captures query data (SQL text, stack frames, timing), optionally runs cProfile, and dumps results to Redis hashes for later retrieval and post-processing.

nodes.name: record_sql
nodes.summary: Replacement for frappe.db.sql that wraps the original call with timing measurement and stack capture. Registers each query's data (text, duration, stack) with the active Recorder instance.

nodes.name: post_process
nodes.summary: Post-processes recorded SQL queries: reformats with sqlparse, collects EXPLAIN output, marks duplicate and normalized-duplicate queries. Runs as background job after recording stops.

nodes.name: normalize_query
nodes.summary: Normalizes SQL queries by replacing literal values with '?' placeholders using sqlparse, enabling detection of structurally similar duplicate queries.

nodes.name: record_queries
nodes.summary: Decorator to profile a specific function using the recorder. Forces recording, captures all SQL queries during execution, then post-processes results.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Whitelisted API to start the recorder. Creates RecorderConfig, stores it in cache, sets intercept flag with auto-disable expiry.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Whitelisted API to stop the recorder. Clears intercept flag and enqueues post_process as background job.

nodes.name: sessions.py
nodes.summary: Redis-backed session management for Frappe. Handles session creation, resumption, expiry, and cleanup. Builds boot info (permissions, defaults, system settings) cached in Redis. Manages CSRF tokens, session records in database and cache.

nodes.name: Session
nodes.summary: Core session class managing user sessions. Handles session start (sid generation, DB insert, cache set), resume (load from cache/DB, validate expiry), and update (extend expiry, persist to DB). Uses __slots__ for memory efficiency. Supports session impersonation.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Gets session boot info. Loads bootinfo from Redis cache or builds fresh via get_bootinfo(). Extends with change_log, translations, app data, navbar settings, and runs extend_bootinfo hooks.

nodes.name: clear_sessions
nodes.summary: Clears other sessions for a user at login/logout. Respects simultaneous_sessions setting unless force=True.

nodes.name: delete_session
nodes.summary: Deletes a session by sid from both database (Sessions table) and Redis cache. Logs the logout event via activity log feed.

nodes.name: get_expiry_period
nodes.summary: Returns session expiry period from System Settings (default 240:00:00). Normalizes format to HH:MM:SS.

nodes.name: generate_csrf_token
nodes.summary: Generates a new CSRF token hash and stores it in session data. Forces session update except during tests.

nodes.name: share.py
nodes.summary: Document sharing permission system. Manages DocShare records that grant read/write/submit/share permissions to specific users or everyone. Validates permissions before granting, supports custom permission types, and sends share notifications.

nodes.name: add_docshare
nodes.summary: Creates or updates a DocShare record to share a document with a user. Sets read/write/submit/share permissions, supports custom permission types, validates share permissions, sends notifications, and optionally triggers document follow.

nodes.name: set_docshare_permission
nodes.summary: Sets a specific permission on an existing or new DocShare. Handles permission cascading (unsetting read also unsets write/submit/share). Deletes DocShare if all permissions are removed.

nodes.name: get_shared
nodes.summary: Returns list of shared document names for a given user and DocType, filtered by specified rights (read/write/share). Includes documents shared with everyone.

nodes.name: check_share_permission
nodes.summary: Validates that the current user has share permission on the doctype and possesses all permissions they are trying to grant. Supports custom permission types.

nodes.name: notify_assignment
nodes.summary: Sends a notification to the user when a document is shared with them. Creates notification log entry of type 'Share'.

nodes.name: test_runner.py
nodes.summary: Deprecated test runner module (to be removed in v17). Re-exports all functions from frappe.deprecation_dumpster for backward compatibility: main, get_modules, make_test_objects, make_test_records, etc.

nodes.name: translate.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive i18n/translation system for Frappe. Handles language detection (form dict, cookies, headers, user settings), loading translations from CSV and MO files, merging app and user translations with Redis caching, extracting translatable strings from Python/JS/HTML/Vue files, and managing translation CSV files.

nodes.name: get_language
nodes.summary: Determines the user's language with priority: form_dict._lang > cookie (preferred_language) > Accept-Language header > User document language > System Settings. Only checks cookies/headers for guest users.

nodes.name: get_user_lang
nodes.summary: Gets the language for a user from User document, falling back to System Settings, frappe.local.lang, then 'en'.

nodes.name: get_all_translations
nodes.summary: Loads the complete translation dictionary for a language by merging: parent language app translations, child language app translations, parent user translations, child user translations, and translated country names. Results cached in Redis.

nodes.name: get_translations_from_apps
nodes.summary: Combines translations from CSV files and MO (gettext) files across all installed apps for a given language. Handles derivative languages by merging parent translations first.

nodes.name: get_messages_for_app
nodes.summary: Extracts all translatable messages for an app by scanning doctypes, pages, reports, workflows, custom fields, JS include files, server code, and navbar settings.

nodes.name: get_messages_from_file
nodes.summary: Extracts translatable strings from a code file (.py, .js, .html, .vue). Uses babel for Python extraction and custom JS parser. Tracks scanned files to avoid duplicates.

nodes.name: extract_messages_from_python_code
nodes.summary: Extracts translatable strings from Python code using babel's extract_python with _() and _lt() as keywords. Returns list of (lineno, source_text, context) tuples.

nodes.name: extract_messages_from_javascript_code
nodes.summary: Extracts translatable strings from JavaScript code using a custom JS parser. Returns list of (lineno, source_text, context) tuples.

nodes.name: write_translations_file
nodes.summary: Writes a translation CSV file for an app and language. Gets app messages and full translation dict, then writes CSV at [app]/translations/[lang].csv.

nodes.name: clear_cache
nodes.summary: Clears all translation caches (bootinfo, user translations, merged translations) from Redis and regenerates the translation version.

nodes.name: print_language
nodes.summary: Context manager that temporarily switches frappe.local.lang and resets jenv for printing in a specific language, restoring originals on exit.

nodes.name: twofactor.py
nodes.summary: Two-factor authentication system supporting OTP App (TOTP), SMS, and Email verification methods. Manages OTP secrets (encrypted), QR code generation, token caching in Redis, and verification flow. Integrates with login manager and supports IP-based 2FA bypass.

nodes.name: two_factor_is_enabled
nodes.summary: Checks if 2FA is enabled globally via System Settings, with optional bypass for users with restricted IP addresses matching the current request IP.

nodes.name: authenticate_for_2factor
nodes.summary: Initiates 2FA authentication: generates OTP token, creates temp ID, caches 2FA data, and sets verification object in response for the client to prompt user.

nodes.name: confirm_otp_token
nodes.summary: Verifies OTP token against both HOTP (for SMS/Email) and TOTP (for OTP App). Tracks login attempts via login attempt tracker. Handles expired login sessions.

nodes.name: cache_2fa_data
nodes.summary: Caches 2FA data (user, password, OTP secret, token) in Redis with expiry times. Uses Redis pipeline for atomic operations. SMS/Email get longer expiry (300s) than OTP App (180s).

nodes.name: get_otpsecret_for_
nodes.summary: Retrieves or generates the OTP secret for a user. Secrets are stored encrypted in defaults and decrypted on retrieval. Generates random 10-byte base32-encoded secret for new users.

nodes.name: get_verification_obj
nodes.summary: Routes 2FA verification to the appropriate method handler (SMS, OTP App, or Email) based on System Settings configuration.

nodes.name: send_token_via_sms
nodes.summary: Sends OTP token via SMS using SMS Settings. Supports hook override via send_token_via_sms hook. Enqueues SMS sending as background job.

nodes.name: send_token_via_email
nodes.summary: Sends OTP token via email using frappe.sendmail with retry. Uses HOTP to generate the verification code from token and secret.

nodes.name: reset_otp_secret
nodes.summary: Whitelisted API to reset a user's OTP secret. Requires System Manager role (unless self-reset). Clears stored OTP login and secret defaults, sends notification email.

nodes.name: ExpiredLoginException
nodes.summary: Custom exception raised when a 2FA login session has expired (OTP secret no longer in cache).
